text: 分享几点男生真实的一面：
en: Let me share a few glimpses of the real side of boys:

text: 1.当你在公交车、地铁或者马路上，看到戴耳机的男生…
en: 1. When you see a boy wearing headphones on the bus, the underground, or the road…

text: 你可能并不知道他听的是摇滚/小跳蛙/白金disco/威风堂堂/红楼梦评说…
en: You probably don't know whether he's listening to rock / Little Jumping Frog / Platinum Disco / Majestic and Dignified / a commentary on Dream of the Red Chamber…

text: 或者像我这样，什么都不听。
en: Or like me, listening to nothing at all.

text: 戴耳机就表示“生人勿近”，也不想摆表情，哪怕整个世界都群魔乱舞了，淡定走过去。
en: Wearing headphones signals 'strangers keep away', and he doesn't want to put on a face either; even if the whole world is dancing in chaos, he walks past calmly.

text: 但是也会破功，当你看到熟人的时候，深吸一口气，耳机摘掉，开始自如地交流。
en: But it can break down too: when he spots an acquaintance, he takes a deep breath, removes his headphones, and starts chatting with ease.

text: 遇到印度的朋友，那就用英语自如地交流。
en: When he meets friends from India, he chats with them easily in English.

text: 遇到欧美的朋友，交流的时候顺便把表情做得夸张一点。
en: When he meets friends from Europe or America, he makes his expressions a bit more exaggerated while talking.

text: 遇到中国的师兄姐，言语中透露着乖巧。
en: When he meets Chinese senior schoolmates, his words reveal a well-behaved manner.

text: Orz
en: Orz

text: 2.很怕女生问他完全不懂的问题。
en: 2. He is terribly afraid of girls asking him questions he knows nothing about.

text: 超级怕，其实男生本身是很友善的，但是就是会说错话。
en: He's super afraid; actually boys themselves are very friendly, but they just end up saying the wrong thing.

text: —女：“诶，你说我染头发偏红色还是黄色好一点啊？
en: —Girl: 'Hey, do you think I'd look better with reddish or blonde hair?'

text: —男：染黄色吧，这样可以显得皮肤白。
en: —Boy: Dye it blonde, that way it'll make your skin look fairer.

text: （美滋滋以为自己说对了）
en: (smugly thinking he'd said the right thing)

text: —女：哈？
en: —Girl: Huh?

text: 不行，头发黄了衬得皮肤也黄了，我本来就是黄皮。
en: No way, blonde hair makes my skin look yellow too, and I'm already yellow-skinned.

text: —男os：你还知道自己是黄皮？
en: —Boy (inner monologue): You do know you're yellow-skinned?

text: —男：那你就染红色…
en: —Boy: Then dye it red…

text: —女: 列举红头发的几个罪状…
en: —Girl: lists several sins of having red hair…
—Boy: ?

text: 那我选哪个，更不能说随便吧，不是说好的直男少说随便么？
en: Then which should I choose? I can't just say 'whatever' either — wasn't it settled that straight guys should say 'whatever' less?

text: 我这种时尚半导体，都不敢告诉女生朋友选啥色号了，对方一定会反选。
en: A fashion semi-conductor like me wouldn't even dare tell a girl friend which shade to pick, because she'd definitely pick the opposite.

text: 3.男生多多少少有点妈宝。
en: 3. Boys are more or less a bit of a mama's boy.

text: 个人的理解是，如果从小男孩的妈妈对他很好，那他长大了更加会孝顺父母。
en: My understanding is that if a boy's mother was very good to him from childhood, then when he grows up he'll be even more filial to his parents.

text: 如果男孩的妈妈没有给太多关爱，男孩也会理解母亲，还是孝顺母亲。
en: If a boy's mother didn't give him much care, the boy will still understand his mother and remain filial to her.

text: 所以你和他妈妈比什么?
en: So what are you competing with his mother for?

text: 女生不要主动把男生放在很尴尬的位置。
en: Girls shouldn't take the initiative to put boys in an awkward position.

text: 而且这事儿根本就说不出谁更重要来。
en: Besides, in this matter there's simply no telling who is more important.

text: 现在已经不流行问掉水里救谁的问题了，因为解决办法太多了。
en: Nowadays it's no longer fashionable to ask who you'd save if someone fell in the water, because there are too many solutions.

text: 我身边的青年情侣，已经开始讨论“你说我们以后有了孩子，你妈还非要用土方法养孩子，怎么办啊”“将来我们结婚了，大年初一可不可以在我爸妈那过年”
en: The young couples around me have already started discussing 'say we have a child in future and your mum still insists on raising the kid with folk remedies, what then' and 'once we're married, can we spend the first day of the lunar new year at my parents' place'

text: 拜托你俩不是上个月才在一起的么？
en: Please, didn't you two only get together last month?

text: 你就让他妈宝，他妈宝他妈，你妈宝你妈，社会是不是更和谐了？
en: Just let him be a mama's boy to his mum, and you be a mama's boy to your mum — wouldn't society be more harmonious?

text: 4.男生很多角度看，是个蛮体贴人的物种。
en: 4. From many angles, boys are quite a considerate species.

text: 比方说，晚上打完游戏，伸个懒腰，掏出手机问候女朋友（我没有，md烦躁）。
en: For example, after finishing a game at night, he stretches, pulls out his phone to message his girlfriend (I don't have one — damn, so annoying).

text: 然后女生说：哎哟，你现在想起来和我说话了啊…
en: Then the girl says: Oh, so you remembered to talk to me now…

text: 其实男生真的是体贴你，所以在第一时间去和你说话了。
en: Actually the boy really is being considerate of you, which is why he came to talk to you first thing.

text: 不然总有可以玩的东西，然后就忘记回复你了。
en: Otherwise there'd always be something to play with, and then he'd forget to reply to you.

text: 但是女生如果比较长时间不回复你，你哎哟一个试试？
en: But if a girl doesn't reply for quite a while, you just try going 'oh' and see?

text: 更不要说男生在纪念日/节日，给你送的丑不拉几的礼物了。
en: Not to mention the hideous gifts boys give you on anniversaries / festivals.

text: 请看重他的心意，宽容他的审美。
en: Please value his intention and be tolerant of his sense of beauty.

text: 5.男生分两种，一种是极度干净+整理癖，一种是所有东西都乱放，别看打扮看细节最好。
en: 5. Boys come in two types: one is extremely clean with a tidying obsession, the other leaves everything in a mess; don't judge by their dress, it's best to look at the details.

text: 从穿着打扮看似乎看不大出来，但是从上课他怎么从书包掏出来东西，还有整理东西，是可见一斑的。
en: You can't really tell from how they dress, but you can get a glimpse from how they take things out of their bag in class, and how they organise their things.

text: 我属于书包里只要有A4纸打印的东西，就一定会找一个塑料文件夹包起来，怕皱了。
en: I'm the type who, as long as there's something printed on A4 paper in my bag, will definitely find a plastic folder to wrap it in, for fear it gets creased.

text: 笔也是放在笔兜里，上课之前从书包把东西掏出来。
en: Pens go in the pen pouch too; before class I take things out of my bag.

text: 这属于做实验的朋友的基本习惯。
en: This is a basic habit of friends who do experiments.

text: 见过一个哥们，皮肤不大好，（有遗传和之前生病用过激素的原因在。
en: I've seen a mate whose skin isn't great (due to genetic factors and having used hormones when he was ill before.

text: 但是其实是房间特别干净的男生，上课之前录音笔/文具/课件/书本/水杯/手机，整齐地排好。
en: But actually he's a boy whose room is especially clean; before class he lines up his voice recorder / stationery / lecture slides / books / water bottle / phone neatly.

text: 课堂笔记记得工工整整，好几种颜色的笔飞来飞去的，可以说是贤良淑德了。
en: His class notes are written neatly and tidily, with several colours of pen flying back and forth — you could say he's positively virtuous and domesticated.

text: 每每赞叹他宜其室家。
en: I constantly admire how he'd make a fine husband and home.

text: 然后我同寝室的男生经常上课借笔，课件不钉在一起翻来覆去找不到哪页…
en: Then there's the boy in my dorm who often borrows pens in class, and whose lecture slides aren't stapled together so he flips back and forth unable to find the right page…

text: 卫生习惯不大好，尚且做不到冬天每天都洗脚…
en: His hygiene habits aren't great; he can't even manage to wash his feet every day in winter…

text: 头发三天没洗，那就戴个帽子吧…
en: Hair not washed for three days, so just wear a hat…

text: 穿衣服都穿特别耐脏颜色的基本款…
en: He wears only basic styles in especially dirt-resistant colours…

text: 但是还是可以给不明真相的女生一种
en: But he can still give girls who are none the wiser a sense of

text: "那天阳光正好，你穿了一件我很喜欢的牛仔衬衫"的感觉
en: 'That day the sunlight was just right, and you wore a denim shirt I really liked' feeling

text: 那衬衫一个多月没洗过，或者说买来估计都没洗过。
en: That shirt hadn't been washed for over a month, or rather probably hadn't been washed since it was bought.

text: 6.最后，男生心中经常以“我是个男人啊”砥砺自己。
en: 6. Finally, boys often steel themselves with the thought 'I am a man' in their hearts.

text: 说好听是社会责任感，说不好听就是有包袱。
en: Put nicely, it's a sense of social responsibility; put less nicely, it's a burden to carry.

text: 所以不管当下心情如何，说话声音要响亮，行为举止要有力又果断。
en: So regardless of his current mood, his voice must be loud, and his behaviour must be forceful and decisive.

text: 看到什么插队blabla都要上…
en: Whenever he sees any queue-jumping or blah-blah, he has to step in…

text: 之前有机会去听孙燕姿的一场音乐会，然后入场地方排了超级长的队伍，还拉了排队用的围栏。
en: I once had the chance to go to a Stefanie Sun concert, and the entrance had a super long queue, with barriers put up for the line.

text: 结果我前面排着的中国游客大妈远远就给人招呼，“快来快来，排这！
en: As a result, an elderly Chinese tourist lady queuing in front of me called out from afar, 'Come quick, come quick, queue here!'

text: 然后呼啦啦来了六个人挤进队伍里了。
en: Then whoosh, six people came and squeezed into the queue.

text: 我当时就和几个大妈说：
en: I then said to the elderly ladies:

text: 大妈们都是中国来的游客对吧，新加坡人通常都是不插队的。
en: You ladies are all tourists from China, right? Singaporeans normally don't jump the queue.

text: 医院急诊室都得按顺序来。
en: Even hospital A&E departments go in order.

text: 而且音乐会有座位，不过是早进去晚进去的差别。
en: Besides, the concert has seats; it's only a difference of going in early or late.

text: 阿姨你们这一口东北口音，新加坡人听得出来你们是中国人的。
en: Ladies, with that Northeastern accent of yours, Singaporeans can tell you're Chinese.

text: 我没直接说大妈不对，就是告诉她们“你们能听出来是中国人”。
en: I didn't directly say the ladies were wrong; I just told them 'you can tell they're Chinese'.

text: 和朋友在坡某个偏远的地方吃越南餐，天桥没有斜坡，一个老太太又有个装满食物手推车，两步一个台阶地往上走，然后我远远看到，就如脱缰的野狗帮老太太搬到对面。
en: Eating Vietnamese food with a friend in some remote part of the island, there was no ramp on the footbridge, and an old lady had a shopping trolley full of food, climbing the steps two at a time; then from afar I saw this and, like a runaway wild dog, helped the old lady move to the other side.

text: 然后对朋友说，诶我们要吃的那家越南餐在哪？
en: Then I said to my friend, 'Eh, where's that Vietnamese place we were going to eat at?'

text: 他说，智障我们并不需要过天桥，然后又回到马路原处了…
en: He said, 'Idiot, we don't even need to cross the footbridge,' and then we went back to where we were on the road…

text: 打菜的时候一个女生说要半份XX菜，半份XX肉。
en: When getting food, a girl said she wanted half a portion of XX vegetable dish and half a portion of XX meat.

text: 结果打饭大叔没听清，各打一份，收她8新币（大约人民币四十），问题是人女生也吃不完啊。
en: But the uncle serving the food didn't hear clearly and gave her a full portion of each, charging her 8 Singapore dollars (about 40 yuan); the problem is the girl couldn't finish it all.

text: 女生怯生生说，我两个都要半份的。
en: The girl said timidly, 'I wanted half portions of both.'

text: 然后大叔把素菜撇去半份…
en: Then the uncle scooped half the vegetable dish away…

text: 我在后面就大声说，她两个菜都要半份，应该是四块。
en: Standing behind her, I said loudly, 'She wanted half of both dishes, so it should be four dollars.'

text: 结果姑娘走了之后，然后大叔给我打的菜，果然比平时少了一点…
en: As a result, after the girl left, the uncle gave me a bit less food than usual…

text: 算了，我不生气。
en: Forget it, I'm not angry.

text: 7.最最后补充一点，男生都是不经夸的。
en: 7. Last of all, one more point: boys can't handle being praised.

text: 男生被夸奖之后，淡定和矜持都是表面现象。
en: After a boy is praised, his calm and reserve are just a surface act.

text: 隔壁班班草，体育课下课从操场回教学楼，远远看到我在二楼，和我招手。
en: The class hunk from the neighbouring class, coming back from the sports field to the teaching building after PE, saw me on the second floor from afar and waved at me.

text: 我就听到我身边的同学说“哇，你看那边有个人好帅哦”。
en: I then heard a classmate beside me say 'Wow, look at that really handsome guy over there.'

text: 或者，同学会悄悄问我“班长，刚刚那个和你一起走路的是谁啊，好帅啊”
en: Or, a classmate would quietly ask me 'Class monitor, who was that walking with you just now, so handsome'

text: 然后我吃饭的时候，不经意透露给他…
en: Then while eating, I casually let it slip to him…

text: 他听到的那一瞬间，眼都亮了，放下筷子问我，有没有好看的妹子介绍我认识！
en: The moment he heard it, his eyes lit up; he put down his chopsticks and asked me if I could introduce him to any pretty girls!

text: 也会上演狂喜的表情，说“是你们的班花今天提到的我么？
en: He'd also put on an expression of wild joy and say 'Was it your class beauty who mentioned me today?'

text: 聊了一会发现并不是他注意到的那个女生，对我们说“淡定、淡定！
en: After chatting for a while we found it wasn't the girl he'd noticed, and he said to us 'Stay cool, stay cool!'

text: 也是戏精好么！
en: He's such a drama queen, honestly!

text: *但是我禁得住夸奖，夸我！
en: *But I can take praise — praise me!

text: 总结：
en: In summary:

text: 大多数男生，对生活都是乐在其中的吧。
en: Most boys, I suppose, quite enjoy life.

text: 不要把男生/女生分得泾渭分明。
en: Don't draw such a sharp distinction between boys and girls.

text: 评论区的污言秽语体现了一个人的表里两面的丑态，已经删除+屏蔽。
en: The foul language in the comments section reveals the ugly duality of a person's inner and outer selves; I've already deleted and blocked it.

text: 男生真实的一面当然也千姿百态，
en: The real side of boys is of course varied and colourful,

text: 你若想知道，就去更了解他。
en: If you want to know, then get to know him better.

text: 因为有时候他自己都不知道自己是什么样。
en: Because sometimes he doesn't even know what he's like himself.

text: 看状态看感觉就自然发挥了。
en: Just go with the state and the feeling and it'll come naturally.

text: 遇强则强，遇爱则爱。
en: Meet strength with strength, meet love with love.
